task_description: Classify a short financial news headline or news tweet about stocks into exactly one event type. Pick the type of the main event. Prefer a specific company event (earnings, analyst_rating, m_and_a, legal_regulatory, management_change, dividend, company_news) over stock_movement, macro_market or other.

labels.earnings: Quarterly or annual results, earnings previews, beats or misses, revenue figures, guidance or outlook changes.
labels.analyst_rating: Analyst or broker actions: upgrades, downgrades, initiations, price target changes, analyst picks and calls.
labels.m_and_a: Mergers, acquisitions, takeover bids, stake purchases, divestitures, spin-offs and strategic investments in other companies.
labels.legal_regulatory: Lawsuits, settlements, fines, investigations, regulatory decisions, antitrust actions and approvals.
labels.management_change: CEO, CFO, board or other executive appointments, departures, retirements and succession.
labels.dividend: Dividend declarations, increases, cuts or suspensions, and share buybacks.
labels.company_news: Other company-specific news: products, contracts, operations, strategy, layoffs, IPOs.
labels.stock_movement: Price moves, stock commentary and technical or trading views on specific stocks without a named underlying event.
labels.macro_market: Economy, central banks, rates, bonds, currencies, commodities, politics and broad market news.
labels.other: General news or opinion with no clear event about a company or the market.

source_mapping.dropped: Financials: sector news about banks and insurers mixes company and macro events, so it has no single target label.
